name: Mengpo
description: A support who brings back Allies to life.

skills.name: Samsara's Shore
skills.description: While having Samsara stacks, consumes one stack to revive a fallen ally and restore 50% of their max HP (Passive). Grants herself one stack of Samsara (Active).

upgrades.level2: Revived units restore 80% of their max HP.
upgrades.level3: Increases the maximum stacks of Samsara to 2.
upgrades.level4: Revived units restore 100% of their max HP.

skills.name: Stone of Three Fates
skills.description: Passive: When an ally is controlled, immediately restores HP equal to 200% of her ATK to them and removes their debuffs. CD: 20s.

skills.name: Waters of Oblivion
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 270% of ATK to the enemy closest to backline allies and inflicts River of Oblivion, moving toward the initial position for 3s.

upgrades.level2: River of Oblivion also reduces the target's CRIT Rate by 30%.

skills.name: Lycoris Bloom
skills.description: Buffs the ally with the highest Energy, increasing their ATK by 15% and restoring 50 Energy per sec to them for 5s.

relic.name: No Return
relic.description: When there are 5 or more surviving allies (excluding minions) on the battlefield, Mengpo traverses the boundary between life and death, making herself untargetable.

upgrades.level2: A unit revived by Samsara gains 200 Energy.
upgrades.level3: Restores 200 Energy whenever an ally falls.
upgrades.level4: When there are 4 or more surviving allies (excluding minions) on the battlefield, Mengpo becomes untargetable.
